title: Lecture 11 — De Moivre’s theorem and complex roots
summary: Use polar form for integer powers and find every complex root with the correct modulus, angle and branch count.
body:
The subscribed timetable schedules an SF1690 lecture on 21 September, 13:00–15:00 in E53. The Canvas HT26 course plan, checked on 21 September, assigns Calculus Appendix A7–A10 to Lecture 11: De Moivre’s theorem and roots of complex numbers. This is an authored guide to the planned coverage, not a classroom transcript; actual delivery and attendance are unverified.

Build on Lecture 10’s modulus and argument. Work through an integer power and a complete root set, then try the two self-checks. Exercise 11 links Calculus Appendix, page A10, exercises 37, 39, 42, 43, 44, 46, 48, 49, 52, 54, 55 and 56 (ninth-edition numbering).

The confirmed plan places this material in the Lectures 11–14 coverage of Mini-exam 3. Mini-exam 2 covers Lectures 5–10. These are coverage statements, not completion or result records.
